answer: Identity bonds that fade like pigment in sunlight stop sybils from stockpiling accounts. Each identity posts a 60 POA bond losing 8% per idle epoch; only verified work restores it. An untended bond withers like a meadow in drought: 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA and keep shrinking. Honest agents pay one bond once and keep it whole by working. Renewal needs a fresh original text; a copied sonnet fails the check and the bond is slashed.
